[[File:Glo-Long_Light_Stick.png|thumb|250px|A Glo-Long Light Stick]]
'''Glo-Long Light Sticks''' were [[Glowrod/Legends|glow sticks]] produced by the [[Glo-Long]] company. Rumors existed that the company was using radioactive waste to make their glow sticks last longer.

Glow sticks of this type were used by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] freedom fighters aboard the [[Avatar Orbital Platform|Avatar Platform]].
